query:
SELECT sp.id, sp.userId, sp.displayName, sp.isActive, sp.isSuspended,
       sp.stripeConnectId, sp.stripeConnectStatus,
       u.email, u.name, u.role
FROM sellerProfiles sp
JOIN users u ON sp.userId = u.id
ORDER BY sp.id;
